name: Claude Code Review
on:

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Claude Review
        run: |
          npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
          claude -p "Review this PR for issues" --output-format json

# Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to repository secrets

examples.title: PR review automation
examples.description: Automatically review pull requests
examples.code:
# .github/workflows/claude-pr-review.yml
name: Claude PR Review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Install Claude
        run: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
      - name: Review PR
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          claude -p "Review this PR. Check for bugs, security issues, and suggest improvements." \
            --print > review.md
      - name: Post Review
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const review = fs.readFileSync('review.md', 'utf8');
            github.rest.pulls.createReview({
              ...context.repo,
              pull_number: context.issue.number,
              body: review,
              event: 'COMMENT'
            });

tips: Start with non-blocking reviews before adding enforcement
Use environment variables for API keys, never commit them
Set appropriate rate limits to control costs
Consider caching Claude's npm package for faster CI runs

examples.title: Automated issue triage
examples.description: Analyze and label new issues automatically
examples.code:
# .github/workflows/issue-triage.yml
name: Issue Triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Claude
        run: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
      - name: Analyze Issue
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          ISSUE_BODY=$(gh issue view ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --json body -q .body)
          claude -p "Analyze this issue and suggest labels: $ISSUE_BODY" --print > analysis.txt
      - name: Apply Labels
        run: |
          # Parse analysis and apply appropriate labels
          gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --add-label "needs-triage"

refactor_ranger.longDescription: The Refactor Ranger achievement celebrates your ability to leverage Claude Code for large-scale refactoring operations across multiple files. Whether restructuring code architecture, renaming modules, extracting shared logic, or updating patterns project-wide, Claude provides the intelligence to make sweeping changes while maintaining code correctness. This capability transforms daunting refactoring projects into manageable, well-executed improvements.
refactor_ranger.whyItMatters: Large refactors are risky without proper tooling. AI-assisted refactoring reduces errors, maintains consistency, and makes architectural improvements feasible.

howTo.summary: Direct Claude to perform multi-file refactoring operations with attention to maintaining functionality and code quality.

steps.code:

"First show me a plan for this refactoring without making changes"
"Start with the user-related API calls. Move them and update all imports."
"Run the tests to make sure nothing broke"

tips: Always create a backup branch before large refactors
Ask for a refactoring plan before execution
Refactor in small, testable increments
Run tests frequently during refactoring

release_automator.longDescription: The Release Automator achievement recognizes your use of Claude Code to streamline the release process. From version bumping in package files to creating git tags, generating release notes, and triggering deployment pipelines, Claude orchestrates the entire release workflow. This automation ensures consistent, well-documented releases while reducing the human error that often plagues manual release processes.
release_automator.whyItMatters: Release processes are critical and error-prone. Automation ensures consistent versioning, complete documentation, and reliable deployments every time.

howTo.summary: Ask Claude to handle the complete release workflow including version bumping, tagging, changelog updates, and release creation.

steps.code:
# In Claude Code session:
"Prepare a release for version 2.1.0"

# Claude updates:
# - package.json version
# - CHANGELOG.md
# - Any other version references

# Claude executes:
# git commit, git tag, git push
# gh release create with notes

examples.title: Complete release workflow
examples.description: Full release automation
examples.code:
# In Claude Code session:
"Create a new release v2.1.0. This is a minor release with new features."

# Claude executes:
# 1. Update version in package.json
npm version minor --no-git-tag-version

# 2. Update CHANGELOG.md
# (generates from commits since last tag)

# 3. Commit version bump
git add .
git commit -m "chore(release): v2.1.0"

# 4. Create and push tag
git tag -a v2.1.0 -m "Release v2.1.0"
git push origin main --tags

# 5. Create GitHub release
gh release create v2.1.0 \
  --title "v2.1.0" \
  --notes-file CHANGELOG.md \
  --latest

examples.description: Create beta or RC releases
examples.code:

"Create a beta release 2.2.0-beta.1 for testing the new features"

# 1. Updates version to 2.2.0-beta.1
# 2. Creates pre-release tag
# 3. Publishes as pre-release on GitHub
gh release create v2.2.0-beta.1 \
  --title "v2.2.0-beta.1" \
  --prerelease \
  --notes "Beta release for testing. Not recommended for production."

tips: Create a release checklist in CLAUDE.md for Claude to follow
Use semantic versioning consistently
Test releases on staging before creating production releases
Automate release announcements to Slack/Discord

scaffold_master.longDescription: The Scaffold Master achievement celebrates your use of Claude Code to generate boilerplate code quickly and consistently. Whether creating new React components, API endpoints, test files, or entire feature modules, Claude generates scaffolding that follows your project's patterns and conventions. This automation eliminates the tedious setup work and ensures all new code starts with proper structure.
scaffold_master.whyItMatters: Consistent scaffolding reduces setup time and ensures all new code follows project conventions. It lowers the barrier to creating properly structured features.

test_fixer.longDescription: The Test Fixer achievement recognizes your use of Claude Code to automatically diagnose and fix failing tests. Rather than manually debugging test failures, you let Claude analyze the test output, understand what broke (test logic vs application code), and apply appropriate fixes. Claude can update test expectations, fix application bugs, or both, getting your test suite back to green efficiently.
test_fixer.whyItMatters: Failing tests block deployment and indicate problems. Fast, intelligent test fixes maintain development velocity and keep the feedback loop tight.

howTo.summary: Run your test suite, share failures with Claude, and let it analyze and fix the issues in both tests and application code.

steps.code:
# In Claude Code session:
"Run the tests and fix any failures"

# Claude determines whether to fix:
# - Test expectations (if outdated)
# - Application code (if buggy)
# - Both (if needed)
"Run the tests again to confirm all pass"

Keep test fixes in separate commits from feature changes

test_runner.longDescription: The Test Runner achievement marks your use of Claude Code to execute and interpret test results. Beyond just running test commands, Claude provides intelligent analysis of test output, identifying patterns in failures, suggesting fixes, and helping you understand test coverage. This collaboration between human intent and AI interpretation makes test-driven development more accessible and productive.
test_runner.whyItMatters: Tests are only valuable when you act on results. AI-interpreted test output highlights what matters and suggests next steps, improving development flow.
